about: TL-1's one shared frame fixture (docs/plans/telemetry-links.md): internal/stackframe, internal/mcp (localize) and cmd/fathom (the prompt hook) all read this file. Every case is issue-shaped; frames are the tuples the parser must return, depth 0 the throw site. The sentinel sits in message, breadcrumb, user and metaData fields and in the message line of each raw trace: it must never reach a localize answer built from a payload, nor any hook line.
